name: 8 Coil Shakti 'as seen on TV': chirp both sides, then amygdala left
origin: Todd Murphy (8 Coil Shakti software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Todd Murphy's starred 'as seen on TV' two-phase session for the 8 Coil Shakti: the chirp over both temporal lobes for 20 min, then the amygdala signal over the left temporal lobe for 20 min. The vendor: 'The after-effects should be consistent with left amygdala phenomena. This is the session design that comes closest to the sessions used in the "God Helmet" experiments.'
notes: The vendor's page puts six coils on the left (four left-channel, two right-channel) and two right-channel coils on the right (output_2_phase_1_bi_mod40_chirp_2_l_amy.htm). The 20 + 20 min rests on the demo video (captions at 2:34), not on the page. Phase 1 drives the two right-channel pairs (FTT7h, TTP9h on the left; FTT8h, TTP10h on the right), phase 2 the left-channel cross (FT7, C5, TP7, T9). The site names are this project's reading. Polarity follows the demo video ('all of the coils on the left side of the head are positive', captions at 2:06), so only TTP10h is reversed. This contradicts the vendor's two-pole rule (8_coil_placement.htm) and the page's photo. The chirp is a 40 to 6 Hz sweep, 837 points of 3 ms every 4 s (the Thomas pattern's length, Dixon 2001 p.4 [90]). The vendor describes gaps inside a modulated 40 Hz signal instead ('this one is not a pulse'). The amygdala signal is the project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length (230 points of 3 ms; Ryczko 2002 p.1 [592]), then 4 s of silence; its point values were never published as numbers. The vendor's files are unpublished. The vendor's 10 to 50 mG carries no distance (measurement.htm, duds.htm); an independent meter read 0.1 to 1.0 uT RMS about 9 cm from the coils (Gendle 2012 p.11 [227]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The effects are vendor claims. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The chirp can be 'very unpleasant over the right side'; Skip goes to phase 2. If anger appears during or after the session, do not use it again. Not for people prone to anger, or with epilepsy, a psychiatric condition or medication, migraine or brain injury, or on drugs. Stop on fear or distress.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence ('not just quiet'), at night; eyes closed or blindfolded; relax without meditating or falling asleep. A helper can press Skip or Stop so you stay in the dark. The vendor: 'You don't have to use sensory deprivation if you're looking for after-effects.'
schedule: Vendor: while trying sessions out, at most every 72 h; once you settle on a session, once a week; never on consecutive days. For sessions of an hour or more (the 60-min run) the demo video and the safety pages say once every 3 weeks (one week if the session had no effect), but the vendor's 60-minute page exempts two-phase sessions from that rule.
